q: What are the emissions of running a water softener?
title: Water softener emissions
short: Usually small. A softener uses salt to regenerate its resin, which is a purchased material in Scope 3, and some electricity for pumps and controls in Scope 2. Measure salt bought and pump kWh per kilolitre treated. Soft water can save boiler fuel by reducing scale.
audience: Factories, hotels and hospitals with boilers

ul: Pump and control kWh × 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25.

p: Scale on boiler tubes raises fuel use, so softening often saves more CO2 than it uses.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
